effect_description_eng: [Main] By trashing 1 Digimon card in your hand, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose level is less than or equal to the trashed card's level. When a card with [Myotismon] in its text is trashed by this effect, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
